title: The い-stem: the great connector
summary: The い-stem is the verb's connecting form: it takes ます, helper adjectives like やすい, compounds, joins clauses and makes a noun.

blocks.text: Take a verb's う-row ending and shift it to the い-row (読む → 読み, 食べる → 食べ). That is the **い-stem**, the "connective use form" (連用形). The course calls it **the great connector**, because it does so many different joining jobs. It is not the "base form": ます is just one helper attached to it.
It takes **ます**, plenty of dedicated helper adjectives and nouns, and it joins verbs into compounds, much as the て-form does.

rows: 読みやすい (easy to read), 読みにくい
読み始める, 読み込む
店に行き、パンを買った
休む → 休み, 読む → 読み

blocks.en: This book is easy to read.

blocks.jp: 歩きながらスマホを見ないでください。
blocks.en: Please don't look at your phone while walking.

blocks.jp: 店に行き、パンを買った。
blocks.en: I went to the store and bought bread.

blocks.text: The い-stem can also join with a noun to make a new noun: 泣き + 虫 = 泣き虫 (a crybaby), 読み + 方 = 読み方 (way of reading). A compound takes on the character of its last element, so 読み込み中 is a noun.

items: い-stem = う-ending shifted to the い-row (読む → 読み).
It connects ます, やすい / にくい, ながら, そう, and compounds.
It can join two clauses like the て-form: 行き、買った.
It is also the **noun form** of a verb: 休む → 休み.

questions.instruction: What is the い-stem of 飲む?
questions.note: Shift the う-row ending to the い-row: む becomes み.

questions.instruction: What is the い-stem of 食べる?
questions.note: For る-verbs, drop る.

questions.en: This pen is easy to write with.
questions.note: い-stem + やすい = easy to do.
い-stem + ながら = while doing.

questions.en: (She) looks like she's about to cry.
questions.note: い-stem + そう = looks like.

questions.en: These shoes are hard to walk in.
questions.note: い-stem + にくい = hard to do.
The い-stem of 休む is also the noun 休み.

questions.instruction: Which is the noun form of 遊ぶ?
questions.note: The い-stem doubles as a noun.

questions.instruction: Which sentence joins two clauses with the い-stem?
options: 朝は七時に起きる、顔を洗った。
朝は七時に起き、顔を洗った。
朝は七時に起きない、顔を洗った。
朝は七時に起きれば、顔を洗った。
questions.note: 起き is the い-stem, joining the clauses like て.

questions.instruction: What does 食べ終わる mean?
questions.note: い-stem + a verb makes a compound verb.

questions.instruction: How do you say "way of making"?
questions.note: い-stem + 方 = way of doing.

questions.instruction: True or false? The い-stem is used only with ます.
questions.note: ます is just one helper; the い-stem has many jobs.
ながら attaches to the い-stem, not the dictionary form.

questions.prompt: この漢字は覚えにくい。
questions.en: This kanji is hard to remember.
questions.note: い-stem + にくい = hard to do.

questions.note: 会い joins the clauses like a て-form.

questions.en: This park is easy to run in.
questions.note: い-stem 走り + やすい.
い-stem 食べ + ながら.

questions.en: I went to the library and borrowed a book.
questions.note: 行き joins two clauses.

questions.prompt: The winter break was very long.
questions.en: The winter break was very long.
questions.note: 休み is the noun form of 休む.

questions.instruction: Which is the い-stem of 飲む?
questions.note: The last う-sound becomes the い-sound: 飲む → 飲み.

questions.note: A compound takes on the character of its last element.
